The narrative transitions smoothly to the Q4 recovery (S6–S8) and explains the operational and accounting measures that supported margins (S9–S12). Financial discipline and balance-sheet outcomes are presented in a clear sequence (S13–S15), followed by supplementary activities and forward-looking statements (S16–S18). No self-contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational problems are present, and repetition is minimal and purposeful.
